implemented_scope: Native Head CLinker lookup trapezoids from declared reference points, directions, pixel tolerances and part/line limits. Two independent original runs certify exact vertices/adjacent edges and theoretical lines on 3000 controls from 600 actual Laura first-system HEAD builders, including 600 empty areas and ULP limit cases. Ring start/winding only are normalized. No full automatic target/beam/page/registry/SIG/epilog completion is claimed. Existing collector CLI and Laura report are preserved.
